Moving live location versus fixed meeting station; collection-only proxy scope versus changing requested certificate; bounded family sharing of appointment messages while preserving patient contact; mixed sender threads in complaint screenshot; family private message versus outside shipping label; overwritten rental month memo versus actual bank transaction; receipt points versus cash change; lost-hat notice and tree/phone-number posting.
